app.name: Stay in Kosovo
app.metaTitle: Stay in Kosovo - Smart Experience & Mobility App
app.metaDescription: AI-powered Kosovo discovery app for places, events, mobility, itineraries, business onboarding, and local experiences.

offline.message: Offline mode is active. Saved places and itinerary draft stay available locally.

geo.unavailable: Geolocation is unavailable. Using Prishtina center.
geo.denied: Location permission was not granted. Using Prishtina center.

footer.description: Smart discovery, mobility, itineraries, and local business tooling for Kosovo tourism and city life.
footer.aiText: Auditable scoring first, OpenAI narrative layer second.
footer.productionText: Prisma, RBAC, rate limits, Docker, and env-based integrations.

hero.eyebrow: AI-powered experience operating system for Kosovo
hero.title: Stay in Kosovo
hero.description: A mobile-first guide that combines live city pulse, vibe intelligence, smart mobility, business supply, and generated itineraries into one premium Kosovo discovery flow.

mapPreview.title: Live Kosovo experience graph
mapPreview.text: Places, events, weather, and mobility signals update the ranked feed.

weather.cached: Weather updates are cached for 15 minutes.

pulseHome.title: A live operating layer for what is worth doing next.
pulseHome.mapText: Click a pulse card or marker to focus the matching place.
pulseHome.note: Pulse scores feed recommendations, itinerary timing, mobility messaging, and business supply prompts.
pulseHome.emptyText: Choose All Kosovo or another city to view live experience signals.

vibesSection.title: Explore by feeling, not only category.
vibesSection.description: The selected vibe updates recommendations, discovery filters, itinerary generation, and pulse scoring.

aiRecommendations.title: Ranked for {{vibe}} right now.
aiRecommendations.description: The scoring engine blends vibe, distance, quality, budget, hidden-gem signal, mobility, context, and learned interaction preferences.
aiRecommendations.emptyText: Try another vibe or open Discover to browse all Kosovo places.
aiRecommendations.errorText: The discovery catalog is still available while the recommendation service recovers.

flow.title: From first open to business analytics.

location.title: Location
location.text: The app requests location and falls back to Prishtina center when permission is denied.

recommendations.title: Recommendations
recommendations.text: Vibe and filter intent are sent to the scoring API for ranked places and reasons.

mobility.title: Mobility
mobility.text: Route options estimate duration, cost, carbon score, and transport availability.

itinerary.title: Itinerary
itinerary.text: Ranked places become a timed route with stops, costs, and travel segments.

business.title: Business Signal
business.text: Saves, views, check-ins, reviews, and route requests update business analytics.

personalization.title: Personalization
personalization.text: Interactions can tune future recommendations through user preference vectors.

discover.title: Find the right Kosovo experience now.
discover.description: Search, filter, and map places by vibe, budget, rating, open status, and transportation availability.
discover.relaxedNotice: No exact matches for those filters, so Discover is showing the best available Kosovo experiences instead.
discover.loadFallback: Live discovery data was unavailable, so Discover is showing the local Kosovo dataset.
discover.emptyText: Try broadening the city, vibe, category, or transport filters.

mapPanel.title: Live discovery map
mapPanel.subtitle: Google Maps view with exact stored coordinates.
mapPanel.demand: Simulated demand from saves, views, check-ins, and event heat.

googleMap.label: Interactive Kosovo places map
googleMap.emptyText: Places without numeric coordinates inside Kosovo are not rendered as map markers.
googleMap.staticFallbackText: Add a Google Maps JavaScript API key to show every stored place as an interactive marker.
googleMap.unavailableText: {{message}} Add NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY to enable the interactive map.

reviews.title: Capture what a place feels like.
reviews.description: Reviews become structured signals for atmosphere, crowd level, music vibe, local popularity, and photos.
reviews.commentPlaceholder: Books, warm lights, easy conversations, and a very local crowd...
reviews.success: Review submitted and ready for moderation analytics.

itinerary.title: Build a smart day in Kosovo.
itinerary.description: The engine ranks places, estimates mobility, assigns time blocks, and keeps the plan inside budget.
itinerary.emptyText: Try Nightlife for a Prishtina evening, Adventure for Rugova or Brezovica, or Local Food for a restaurant-led city plan.

mobility.title: Plan the best way across Kosovo.
mobility.description: Compare walking, taxi, bus, bike, and car routes with travel time, cost, availability, and carbon score.
mobility.noLocationsForCity: No locations available for this city.
mobility.routeVisualization: Route visualization uses service route points now and can plug into Google Maps directions later.
mobility.empty: Select two places and calculate routes to compare travel options.

pulseConsole.title: Monitor demand, mobility pressure, and supply gaps by city.
pulseConsole.mapText: Zones blend demand, quality, hidden gems, events, and route reliability.

business.dashboardTitle: Operate your local supply and ranking signals.
business.dashboardText: Track discovery, routes, saves, check-ins, and recommendation readiness for your business.
business.boostText: Boost score affects only the businessBoost part of ranking and stays capped so organic quality remains the primary recommendation signal.
business.photosText: Upload signatures are generated server-side for Cloudinary. In prototype mode, uploads become local previews until env vars are added.
business.qrText: Check-ins can drive badges, loyalty, verified visits, and anti-fraud engagement analytics.
business.analyticsText: Analytics update from views, saves, reviews, route requests, itinerary adds, and check-ins.
business.onboardingText: Businesses start pending. Admin approval makes them eligible for public discovery, events, QR check-ins, and recommendation ranking.
business.coordinatesHelp: Use the real entrance or business point. These values become the public map marker.
business.coordinatesInvalid: Enter numeric latitude and longitude inside Kosovo.
business.coordinatesOutside: The detected GPS location is outside Kosovo. Enter the business coordinates manually.
business.geolocationUnavailable: This browser does not support GPS location.
business.geolocationDenied: GPS permission was denied. Enter coordinates manually.
business.descriptionPlaceholder: What should travelers and locals know?
business.visibility: Boosted in Chill, Local Food, and Hidden Gems

admin.title: Manage trust and marketplace quality.
admin.description: Admin actions approve supply, moderate social content, and protect recommendation quality.

auth.loginTitle: Sign in to Stay in Kosovo.
auth.loginHelp: Use seeded credentials after `npm run db:seed`, or configure Google OAuth in `.env`.
auth.loginFailed: Login failed. Run the Prisma seed or check credentials.
auth.seeded: Tourist: tourist@staykosovo.dev · Owner: owner@staykosovo.dev · Admin: admin@staykosovo.dev
auth.registerHelp: Tourist accounts can save places and generate itineraries. Business owners can submit profiles for approval.
auth.created: Account created. You can now sign in.

assistant.title: AI travel assistant
assistant.subtitle: Uses recommendation engine context
assistant.initial: Ask for a perfect evening, food tour, hidden gem, or mobility-friendly plan.
assistant.error: I could not reach the assistant API. Try again after the app reconnects.

notFound.title: This route is not on the map.
notFound.text: Return to discovery and choose a new Kosovo experience.

vibeDescriptions.chill: Quiet cafes, parks, easy walks, and calm views.
vibeDescriptions.nightlife: Bars, late kitchens, live sets, and social streets.
vibeDescriptions.romantic: Sunset viewpoints, warm lighting, dinner, and walks.
vibeDescriptions.adventure: Mountains, canyons, ski routes, and high-energy plans.
vibeDescriptions.local-food: Traditional kitchens, modern bistros, and food tours.
vibeDescriptions.hidden-gems: Less obvious spots with strong local signal.
vibeDescriptions.family-friendly: Daytime, accessible, safer routes, and easy pacing.
vibeDescriptions.culture: Museums, landmarks, architecture, and local identity.
vibeDescriptions.sacred-spiritual: Monasteries, mosques, churches, and reflective heritage spaces.
vibeDescriptions.adventure-trails: Hikes, caves, waterfalls, and outdoor routes for active travelers.
vibeDescriptions.wildlife-nature: Ethical animal encounters, protected landscapes, and nature-led day trips.
vibeDescriptions.living-history: Museums, memorials, bazaars, and places where Kosovo's past stays visible.
vibeDescriptions.ottoman-heritage: Ottoman-era bazaars, hammams, mosques, bridges, and old-town textures.
vibeDescriptions.city-life: Squares, boulevards, cafes, and social urban gathering points.
